original_card.question: What exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained?
methods: Compare exact heads and retained artifacts to write a source-bound disposition receipt.
Audit an existing receipt for missing content or predecessor attribution.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Separate complete integration, partial retention and changed heads; make no autonomous closures.

first_step.inspect: Read one small PR set in the ledger and identify exact reviewed heads and unresolved content.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Compare that set to retained artifacts; produce a complete or explicitly partial disposition receipt.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material.
allowed_variations: One small related PR family or one existing integration receipt.
scope_change_triggers: Treating matching titles or one shared blob as proof of full incorporation.

actual_scope: For the eight pull requests named first in certificates/selected-result.json source_prs, separate byte retention of each ledger integration path from the ledger disposition and from the selected-record role. Do not change any disposition.
scope_change_reason: The overlap-receipt card asks for one small named PR set. This set is the selected frontier's own source_prs prefix at base 32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04: 5413, 5414, 5402, 5407, 5398, 5400, 4610 and 5241. The question is retention versus disposition, not a new supplier.
bottleneck_link: The selected conditional kappa cites these eight pulls. A later reader who trusts only the partially_reviewed rows would drop predecessors the selected record still names, and a reader who treats source_prs as a replay would over-claim 5398 and 5400.
stop_rule: Stop after the eight-row retention table. Do not edit the ledger, do not replay the frontier, and do not promote a partially_reviewed row.
evidence: verify.py checks ancestry, byte-identical research trees, the 1245-file frontier manifest, ledger dispositions, and the promotion and contributor sentences. It rejects a forged incorporated label on 5398 and a forged manifest mismatch.
